counts_for: P4 rounds only; R1 is judged on a later pre-registered confirmation evaluation, registered only if a round passes on all ten seeds
motivation: session 1's four runs are spent and all failed 0/10 (rounds 1-3 on the pre-ADR-465 trainer; r4-anglesonly, the only run on the fixed trainer, stands still: W5-steps 0, W8-high 1.0, W3 -0.004..0.088). Session 1's registered prompt could not tell the agent about ADR-465, and its closing report credits r4's closed train/eval gap to the input change alone; this session's prompt states ADR-465 and the confound

continue_prompt.known_conflict: its text says 'four runs ... in total'; a resumed turn would read that as already spent. Session 1 ran all four runs in its first turn, so a second turn is not expected; if one happens and stops at once, that is recorded as the driver's limit, not as the agent's choice

trainer.rule: ADR-465 and ADR-466 (digest at import); a run's trainer_sha256 now names the code it ran

per_run.seed_rule: the product agent chooses it at train_start; train_start refuses any of 1101-1110
per_run.registered_by: train_start writes runs/<run>/registration.json and a train_registered ledger row before launch

wall_clock_bound: 2 turns; at most 3 runs of at most 2400 s each; one GPU job at a time (machine training lock)
stop_rule: an evaluation passes on every seed, or the ledger reaches 7 evaluations with every run ended, or 2 turns have ended
supervision: rounds.py --max-runs 7 --max-turns 2 under setsid, outliving the actor's session; each training run under its own cadex_cli.loop supervisor
mechanism: fixed for the session: the spec's HIP_MM, WEIGHT_N and SPEC_LIFT are this model's
after: after each evaluation the script's spec block is compared with retained/walk-spec-block.txt; a difference voids that evaluation
